reason: I already pay for AngelSense every month and I know it works, so this would be a second monthly bill on top of it, and I have no proof a camera on a lanyard will stay on my son for a day. I'd be paying $249 to find out.
objection: They will just pull it off or refuse to wear it, and then the live video and GPS are worth nothing when I need them.
would_change_my_mind: A trial I could return for a full refund if he won't keep it on, plus proof it works on a kid who takes things off.
